test_title: PYST 77: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment in which the article has been used INCORRECTLY.

In the recent past, the IT industry has emerged / as a major contributor to an industry revenue / as well as employment / opportunity provider in the country.

options.text: In the recent past, the IT industry has emerged
as a major contributor to an industry revenue

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the article "an" before "industry revenue".
 
• "Industry revenue" is not a specific singular countable noun that requires an article.
 
• The correct phrase should be "contributor to industry revenue," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"In the recent past, the IT industry has emerged as a major contributor to industry revenue as well as employment opportunity provider in the country."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"In the recent past, the IT industry has emerged"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **"as a major contributor to industry revenue"** – This is the correct form after the correction.
 
• **"as well as employment"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **"opportunity provider in the country."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
